text:
alex.w: FYI — we have an active issue: streaming responses from /v1/stream are sometimes emitting duplicated chunks (2-3x repeats) for hosted models in us-west1. Non-streaming endpoints appear unaffected. Customers reporting chat UIs showing repeated tokens. Investigating now. Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3151234567

tara.h: Ack. Saw it in a few honeycomb traces — duplicate spans with identical seq ids. Looks like a fanout replay at the mux layer.

sre-jen: Oncall is on it. Initial mitigation: throttling concurrent stream fanout to 1 per request at the proxy. Rolling that change to us-west1 now (canary 10%).

kevin.l: Can we confirm whether KV cache replay might be replaying prefixes? I don't see cache evictions, but replay could happen if ack loop re-sends chunks.

alex.w: Good call — adding cache team to this thread. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/stream-duplication (temp link).

ops-bot: status-page update queued: "Investigating — some hosted streaming responses in us-west1 may see duplicated chunks. We are deploying a mitigation and will provide updates."

status-page-bot: Public status posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3151234567 — customers notified via banner.

tara.h: Canary at 10% shows dropped duplication counts from ~2.7x -> ~1.05x in first 5m. p99 latency unchanged. Proceeding to 50% if no regression.

kevin.l: Adding temporary circuit-breaker in mux to dedupe identical seq ids for 10s window as safety — low risk. Deploying now.

sre-jen: 50% rollout complete. Duplication metric down to ~1.02x. No impact on throughput. Continuing ramp to 100% in 10m.

alex.w: 100% rollout complete at 3151234589. Post-mitigation checks: customer error reports dropping, telemetry shows duplication within noise. Keeping incident open for 1h monitoring.

tara.h: Postmortem owners: eng-runtime (kevin.l), eng-infra (tara.h), eng-sre (sre-jen). Preliminary blameless notes: race in stream mux fanout retry path.

kevin.l: Drafting short-term hotfix PR and a longer-term fix to remove redundant replay code path. Will file follow-up RFC.

alex.w: Thanks all. Final public update will be posted in 30m after monitoring window. If anyone sees customer-facing regressions, @pager oncall. :thumbsup:
